title: Phone confirms each message reached Tally

requirements.text: After TJ sends a message from the phone, the phone clearly shows and says when it was received by the laptop, and again when Tally has started on it
requirements.check: TJ sends a phone message and can tell, without looking at the laptop, that it arrived and is being worked on; a message that never arrives shows as not delivered

text: Each phone message shows its stage in the chat label and, while it is the latest, big on the digest screen: sending, delivered (the laptop has it), picked up (Tally started on it), or not delivered with Retry
check: file: Link.kt/MainActivity.kt/Focus.kt + gradle build; eye on Pixel

text: The bridge names which phone message Tally picked up (started carries of=message id)
check: node --test mobile/bridge/test: e2e say -> started.of equals the say id

text: A message that never gets the laptop's ack within 20s, or that was unconfirmed when Android killed the app, shows as not delivered with Retry and plays a distinct failure sound
The picked-up sound is distinct and as loud as the others

evidence: e2e.test.mjs 'dictated text reaches the Assistant': started.of === ack.of (the say id); bridge suite 35 pass 0 fail

OutboxTest: pending+failed ME lines survive encode/decode as Stage.FAILED with file kept, delivered/picked do not; Link.fail plays Cues.failed (falling 494->349Hz); 20s timer and relay error both go through fail; gradlew testDebugUnitTest 13 tests 0 fail
Cues.kt: started is now a 587Hz double tap at the default 0.3 volume (was a single 440Hz note at 0.22)

text: Built: stage per message (sending/delivered/picked/not delivered) in chat label and digest screen, bridge started.of, outbox survives app kill, failure sound, louder picked-up cue. Bridge restarted 16:41Z; APK 0.1.454600 on the R2 link. Morning's lost message never reached the bridge (no 'phone said' 15:58-16:00Z). Left: TJ eye check (reqs 1, 2). Not committed.
In 0.1.454756 (R2). Left: TJ eye check reqs 1-2: rising notes then double tap, Delivered -> Tally is working; airplane mode -> Not delivered + falling sound + Retry. Not committed.
